title: Surface state is updated before show operations are known to succeed
reasoning: showChatWindow sets primarySurface to 'chat' before showChatWindowRuntime returns, and showMainWindow sets mainWindowMode, primarySurface, and startupChatPillShowHandled before showMainWindowRuntime returns. If either runtime helper fails or returns a failure result, exported getters can report that the active surface changed even though the window transition did not apply. The main-window path can also mark startup handling complete after a failed show, affecting later startup chat-pill behavior.
recommendation: Move primarySurface, mainWindowMode, and startupChatPillShowHandled updates after the runtime helper returns success, or explicitly roll them back on failure. Keep any intentional pre-state mutation documented and covered by tests.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for this feature, and the package manifest only shows broad Jest commands rather than focused coverage for failed surface transitions.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a Jest test for createSurfaceRuntime where showChatWindowRuntime/showMainWindowRuntime is mocked or dependency-injected to fail, then assert getPrimarySurface/getMainWindowMode/startup suppression state do not advance on failure.
minimumFixScope: Limit the fix to the two show methods' state mutation order and add focused runtime tests around success and failure results.
